notes: Standard WooCommerce shop loop (54 products, 12/page = ~5 pages, 'Näytetään tulokset 1–12 / 54'). Selectors are the standard WooCommerce theme class names (li.product, .woocommerce-loop-product__title, span.price) confirmed by page content/markup patterns (add-to-cart query params, 'Lisää ostoskoriin' buttons) via fetch, but not verified against raw devtools HTML, hence medium confidence. Out-of-stock items show an overlay badge with text 'Loppu varastosta'/'Out of Stock' and their 'Lue lisää' link replaces the add-to-cart button - in_stock left null; treat presence of that badge text or the li carrying WooCommerce's 'outofstock' class as out-of-stock. Ticket 17: '/ennakkotilaukset/' is the shop's preorder category (8 products at audit time, all Pokémon — the shop sells nothing else). Its '/page/2/' serves page 1 again instead of 404ing. The runner now stops at a page whose product names repeat the previous page's, so that costs one wasted fetch rather than every remaining max_pages fetch, and no longer logs the 'max_pages may be too low' warning. Ticket 18: only 'Pre order' is mapped from '.acoplw-blockText' (3 on the current listing). Sold-out cards carry the longer 'Out of Stock' in the same element, which would win the longest-key match, so they are left to fall through to the WooCommerce container classes. 2026-09-02: the six pokemon-tcg sub-category URLs collapsed into the one parent category, '/en/product-category/pokemon-tcg/' ('Showing 1-12 of 161 results', 14 pages, max_pages 16 for headroom).
